purpose: Form SH-1 is used for recording particulars of every share certificate issued in lieu of an original certificate for the purpose of transfer to the IEPF.
who: Company Secretary or person authorised by the Board
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Board authorises the Company Secretary or any other person to sign necessary documents.
Company Secretary or the authorised person makes an application on behalf of the shareholder to the company for a new share certificate.
Company issues a new share certificate with the required statement on the face.
Record the particulars of the share certificate in Form No. SH-1.
Inform the depository by way of corporate action to convert the shares into DEMAT form and transfer to the Authority.
checklist: Verify the share certificate particulars to be entered in Form No. SH-1.
Ensure the new share certificate states it is issued in lieu of the previous certificate for IEPF transfer.
Record the new certificate in the register maintained for the purpose.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
